source_corrections.basis: Both reactants contain two oxygen atoms; add product multiplicity 2 to conserve oxygen.
Three reactant densities require coefficient m^6/s; numerical value preserved.
Move the printed [O2] density factor into explicit three-body mass action; do not double-count.
Add emitted electron for charge conservation; separate printed [O] factor into third reactant.

omitted_reactions.reason: Printed reaction destroys one positive charge without an electron. Replacing O2+ with neutral O2 would conserve charge but is an unverified interpretation, so the solver excludes k49.
omitted_reactions.effect: Full 49-reaction reproduction not achieved; no success assertion permitted.

energy_source.title: On the plasma parameters of a planar inductive oxygen discharge
energy_source.location: Table 3, p.1330; requested by 2001 eq.(3), p.1101

O.source: NIST Atomic Spectra Database, neutral oxygen ground-state ionization energy

O2.source: NIST Chemistry WebBook SRD69, evaluated molecular oxygen ionization energy

supplementary_ionization_energies_ev.role: Supplementary physical threshold values, not numerical values explicitly verified in the 2001/2000 paper. Rate-fit activation parameters are not thresholds.

missing_terms: Numerical kel(O) and kel(O2) are not published in either inspected table.
Source papers do not explicitly specify ionization-energy values. Supplementary NIST thresholds are supplied, but the authors' exact convention remains unverified.
The 2001 electronegative sheath-edge closure eqs.8–16 requires implementation; source-26 eqs.17–18 are a different earlier approximation.
energy_balance.note: Activation values in the particle rate fits must not be used as excitation threshold energies. Source-26 table3 O2(a) rate differs from particle reaction k18; table3 is retained for the energy budget as instructed by the 2001 paper.

wall_assumptions.hR: hL for the paper's short cylinder L<2R, section 2.1 p.1104
wall_assumptions.cross_section_note: Ion-neutral momentum-transfer cross section: atomic value cited, molecular value assumed equal by authors, p.1103.
wall_assumptions.silicon_applicability: These wall probabilities are not Si electrode coefficients. No Si default is supplied.

validation.reason: Reaction k49 unresolved; elastic energy and complete particle/wall/flow closure still require implementation and verification.
validation.published_number_uncertainty: No uncertainty is stated for section-3.2 textual density values; null does not mean zero uncertainty.
